rationale: Forward-flow re-execution of the already-known H-004 Daily Dual Moving Average with Volatility Regime Filter candidate under the current post-WP-5b measurement pipeline. This plan is authored before execution to prove that the going-forward Experiment Plan / Report contract can coexist with the historical retrospective H-004 artifacts EXP-0005 and REP-0005 without replacing, renaming, or reinterpreting them.
hypothesis_to_test: A daily 50/200 SMA crossover strategy with a realized-volatility regime filter on BTCUSDT perpetuals will generate OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs, capture both bullish and bearish daily trend regimes when volatility is supportive, reduce low-quality crossover exposure by staying flat in low-volatility regimes, and survive the current promotion-gate evaluator under the post-WP-5b pipeline.

gates: D2-006 promotion gates from docs/onboarding/PHASE2_BASELINE.md as implemented by the current post-WP-5b lib.evaluation.check_promotion_gates
additional_criteria: Plan file EXP-0011 is authored and validated before the H-004 re-execution begins
The run uses the exact registered H-004 baseline parameters and committed H-004 signal logic
The run appends exactly one new generated trial entry to research/trial_log.jsonl
The resulting report references the actual generated trial_id and actual current-run metrics
Historical retrospective H-004 artifacts EXP-0005 and REP-0005 remain unchanged alongside the new forward-flow pair
No candidate registration, data procurement, schema, validator, query-layer, test, runtime, or promotion change occurs
